thought: Hu Fucai is the other cheerful soldier, often paired with Hu Delin. He's clever and resourceful, actively using stones against enemies and holding the last grenade. His distinctive feature must differentiate him from: Ma Baoyu (binoculars, thick eyebrows), Ge Zhenlin (muscular, rolled sleeves, square jaw), Song Xueyi (round face, neat uniform), and Hu Delin (askew cap with tousled hair). Since Hu Fucai is characterized by his resourcefulness in gathering stones and carrying the crucial last grenade, the most effective distinctive feature would be a canvas utility satchel bag slung diagonally across his chest - a practical item for carrying stones and grenades that none of the other soldiers have. This combined with a slightly younger, leaner appearance (suggesting agility and quickness) makes him immediately recognizable. The satchel is the primary visual anchor.
distinctive_features: Canvas utility satchel bag slung diagonally across his chest, slightly younger appearance with lean, agile build
prompt: Full body portrait of an Eighth Route Army soldier standing in an alert, agile stance, embodying cleverness and resourcefulness. The man has a distinctively younger appearance with a lean, agile build suggesting quickness and energy. Most prominently, a canvas utility satchel bag is slung diagonally across his chest from shoulder to hip, marking him as the resourceful fighter who gathers stones and carries the crucial last grenade. He wears a blue-gray Eighth Route Army uniform jacket, standard military cap with red star emblem worn properly, brown leather belt with grenades visibly attached, dark cotton pants, and cloth shoes. A rifle is slung across his back. Centered composition, symmetrical framing, eye-level angle. The subject stands against a single colored deep prussian blue background with high contrast separation, creating a clear silhouette. Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting from the front-right, casting strong shadows that emphasize the diagonal line of the satchel across his torso and his youthful, alert features. Cool to neutral color temperature with low-saturation earth tones - muted slate blues, weathered canvas tan for the satchel, dusty grays, and earthy browns. The lighting highlights the texture of the canvas bag and the grenades at his belt. Solemn yet spirited atmosphere, reflecting the resourcefulness and determination required in 1941 wartime China. Realistic, thick-painted 2D animation style with bold, visible brushstrokes and strong contrast between illuminated and shadowed areas, emphasizing the harsh, dignified, and epic nature of historical warfare. Deep focus keeping the entire figure sharp from head to toe. Non-distorted portrait lens with natural perspective. The overall mood conveys quick-witted adaptability, youthful energy, and readiness for action. Cultural portraiture, historically accurate 1941 Chinese Eighth Route Army uniform and equipment, realistic rendering with painterly texture.
ref_description: Younger soldier with canvas satchel bag slung diagonally across chest
